description: Server-side rendering: HTML is produced per request on the server, then hydrated in the browser.
HTML produced at build time and served statically. ISR regenerates it later in the background.
`hydrateRoot` renders the same tree on the client, adopts the server DOM nodes and attaches event listeners.
The first client render differs from the server HTML (random values, dates, browser-only APIs). Logged as an error and may force client re-rendering.
`renderToPipeableStream` / `renderToReadableStream` send the shell first and stream Suspense boundaries as data resolves.
